Thanks — attached are a few initial artifacts to get us started: SOC2_TypeII_2025_summary.pdf (one-pager summary) and bcp_redwood_2026.docx (BCP/DR overview and contact points). We're also attaching an initial pass at your questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire_filled_initial.xlsx) with answers to the majority of items; outstanding questions are flagged in the spreadsheet.

Regarding incident response timelines (summary):
- Detection: our monitoring and guards typically flag anomalous activity within ~15 minutes for production alerts (avg; depends on signal).
- Triage/initial investigation: 0-4 hours to categorize and scope (depending on alert severity).
- Containment & remediation: variable by incident severity; for incidents affecting customer data we escalate to a formal IR playbook immediately and target containment within 24 hours where feasible.
- Customer notification: Redwood's standard practice is to notify impacted customers within 48 hours of confirming customer-impacting data exposure; for legal/regulatory obligations we coordinate with counsel and customers to meet contractually required timelines.

Notes: We understand FintechCorp's "without undue delay" requirement. If you can share any contractual notification windows you must adhere to, we will make sure our timelines are aligned.

Forwarding your original questionnaire below for context.

Best,
Jordan Blake
